proposals.label: Confirmed
proposals.rationale: gt-alpha-confirm: 'A 1962 follow-up confirmed the sighting independently' describes a distinct verification action, not equivalent to 'Sighted' or 'Extended the tracked orbit of'.

proposals.label: Claimed
proposals.rationale: gt-beta-contested: 'A contested 2015 press release claimed a further tenfold extension' — this is an unverified assertion, distinct from the confirmed 'Extended the tracked orbit of' action already in the vocabulary.

proposals.label: Downgraded to unconfirmed
proposals.rationale: gt-gamma-downgrade / doc-gamma-ex-1: 'A 1970 review found no independent confirmation and downgraded the claim to unconfirmed' names a distinct evaluative action not covered by 'Sighted' or 'Extended the tracked orbit of'.

proposals.label: Independent review body
proposals.rationale: gt-gamma-downgrade / doc-gamma-ex-1 attribute the downgrade to 'a 1970 review', a specific evaluating actor distinct from the named observatory teams or the unverified observer.

proposals.label: Press release / media source
proposals.rationale: gt-beta-contested attributes the contested extension claim to 'a contested 2015 press release', a specific source type distinct from the Alpha/Beta observatory teams or the unverified observer.
